answer: Commit the hash, reveal after 40 blocks, split verification across 3 auditors that never share a subnet. Any auditor can flag; two flags void the receipt. Maintainer note: the commit map is append-only, so a replayed payload hits the same key and is rejected before scoring. Cost to a farm: 3 auditor seats per 100 receipts, 12 s of compute each, and no receipt reuse across identities. The fable of free clones ends at the commit table; the falcon is the flag; the summit is 40 blocks of waiting.
